clips.title: The story
paras: At Goldshire's crossroads, Gold Dust Exchange brings Remy "Two Times" coin for gold dust from kobolds in Elwynn's mines. Travelers gather the dust and trade it to the nervous broker for pay.

Goldshire sits where Elwynn Forest's roads meet, and travelers, merchants, and guards pass through town. Remy "Two Times" is a shady broker with a habit of repeating his words and a sharp eye for profit. Instead of paying mining crews to dig for raw minerals, he turns to travelers passing through the Lion's Pride Inn. He offers coin for gold dust taken from the kobolds in the region.

Kobolds have overrun Fargodeep Mine south of Goldshire and Jasperlode Mine to the northeast. These rat-like tunnelers chip through the dark for candles and shiny baubles, gathering flecks of unrefined ore in their pouches. Pushing them back serves the kingdom, and gathering their dust turns the work into a trade for coin.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Kobolds in these parts sometimes carry Gold Dust on them. I could really use the stuff - bring me a load of it and I'll give you the best price in town...best price in town!
You can find kobolds in the Fargodeep Mine to the south, and around the Jasperlode Mine to the northeast.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Psst! You have that Gold Dust for me...for me?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thanks for the dust, friend. Here's your cash, and...here is a token from associates of mine. You might find it useful...useful.
